text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Hey, Fuji. You're the culprit, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Huh? What are you talking about?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Don't play dumb! You're the culprit who 
put 'that box' by my pillow!"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that was supposed to be a birthday 
present, but... did you not like it?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I thought so at first too and was 
grateful, you know. But when I opened it, 
wasn't it just a jack-in-the-box?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Hearing that booming voice so early in 
the morning woke me up in an instant!"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, the surprise was a success!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Yeah, but... that's not the only surprise.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Huh? You're telling me there's more?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
You always keep the best trick hidden at 
the bottom of the box. ...Happy birthday, 
Hishi Ama.
